skill.summary: Identify and reduce GCP networking and egress costs across projects and regions

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gcp-networking-optimizer.

- Provides step-by-step guidance to analyze and reduce GCP networking and egress costs.
- Requires users to supply exported billing data or JSON outputs from GCP CLI commands (read-only).
- Outputs clear egress breakdowns, top traffic patterns, and actionable optimization recommendations.
- Includes ROI analysis and Terraform snippet for configuring Private Google Access.
- No credentials required; user privacy and data security emphasized.
